back: A state that keeps its ruler but whose foreign affairs are controlled by a stronger power; Italy claimed Ethiopia was one.
'King of Kings', the title of the Ethiopian emperor.

front: When was the Battle of Adwa fought and who won?
back: 1 March 1896; Ethiopia under Menelik II defeated Italy.

front: When was the Treaty of Wuchale signed?
back: 2 May 1889, between Menelik and Count Antonelli of Italy.

front: What was Article 17 of the Treaty of Wuchale?
back: The article on foreign relations: the Italian text made Ethiopia use Italy; the Amharic text made it optional.

front: What did the Treaty of Addis Ababa (26 October 1896) do?
back: Italy recognised Ethiopian independence and cancelled Wuchale; Italy kept Eritrea.

front: Why did Ethiopia win at Adwa?
back: Menelik's unity and large army, modern rifles, diplomacy and Italian errors.

front: How did Menelik combine diplomacy and arms?
back: He wrote to the powers and played them off against Italy while buying modern weapons.

front: What is a balanced view of Menelik II?
back: He defended Ethiopia against Italy but also expanded its empire at the expense of the Oromo, Sidama and others.
